source.citation: Liu et al., Nature 652, 51-57 (2026), combined with Clark et al., PRL 127, 130505 (2021), and Myerson et al., PRL 100, 200502 (2008)
source.parameter_location: Liu Fig. 4/Supplement B.3 link state and rate; Liu Supplement A.3 storage; Clark Bell-state preparation; Myerson adaptive optical-qubit readout
source.mapping_status: compatible same-isotope optical-qubit components composed into a repeater node; not demonstrated as one integrated system

validity.distance_semantics: each elementary edge is a Liu-style 10 km total fiber link through its midpoint station
validity.route_scope: balanced adjacent-link swapping through 16 elementary hops; no distance interpolation

hardware.resource_semantics: four fixed calcium-ion link/memory lanes per adjacent edge side; an internal degree-two repeater therefore reserves eight ions, with no route-dependent slot optimizer

rate_model.rate_semantics: per-lane valid-pair renewal anchor; fixed parallel lanes affect random-time availability but the reported route service remains conservatively based on one aggregate 0.291/s edge stream

state_model.correlation_source: effective Liu 10 km DI transcript constrained by S=2.5758 and QBER=0.0360
state_model.completion_semantics: Vyy=Vxx Bell-diagonal effective-link completion; using the post-measurement envelope internally is conservative because source SPAM is not deconvolved

bell_basis_transform_model.mapping_semantics: Clark's uncorrected Bell-state preparation fidelity is used as a conservative reciprocal Bell-basis-transform classification envelope, not as average gate fidelity

readout_model.mapping_semantics: two independently reported fluorescence bits identify the complete Bell outcome

component_sources: Clark et al., High-Fidelity Bell-State Preparation with 40Ca+ Optical Qubits, PRL 127, 130505 (2021)
Myerson et al., High-fidelity readout of trapped-ion qubits, PRL 100, 200502 (2008)
local_swap_model.compatibility: Liu and Clark both use 40Ca+ S1/2-D5/2 optical qubits with 729 nm single-qubit control; Clark uses a different D5/2 Zeeman sublevel and a 532 nm entangling force, requiring local recalibration but no species or encoding transduction

storage_decoherence_model.source: Liu Supplementary Eq. (1), measured at alpha=17%
storage_decoherence_model.calibration_status: same Liu memory/KDD apparatus, transferred from the storage operating point to the alpha=2.3% link state as an explicit near-term same-device assumption

memory_model.decay_semantics: anisotropic KDD storage errors enter the local stationary-ion Pauli channels

controller_model.scheduling: independent fixed-lane edge renewal, oldest-live-pair reservation, deterministic adjacent Bell measurements, and balanced nested feed-forward

histogram_adapter.optical_stack_semantics: Liu link effects are aggregated in each empirical accepted-pair instrument; only the separately declared local Bell measurement is added at repeaters

notes: This profile closes the local-swap composability blocker and executes through 16 hops. It is a raw-chain baseline, not a claim that repeated swapping alone preserves Bell violation; purification or encoding must be layered separately when Bell-qualified delivery is required.
